svg.title: End-to-end context-only prefill throughput
svg.desc: DeepSeek-V4-Pro NVFP4 on GSM8K at DEP8: OFF/ON/FB normalized throughput is 1.000/1.069/1.078 on GB200 and 1.000/1.126/1.134 on pre-release Rubin. ON reaches 99.2% and 99.3% of the force-balanced reference.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif
